paper_title: First Results from a Broadband Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter in the $44$ to $52\,μ$eV range with a coaxial dish antenna
notes: First results from GigaBREAD coaxial dish antenna (BREAD collaboration), 24 days of room-temperature data. Excludes chi >~ 1e-12 at 90% CL over 44-52 ueV (10.7-12.5 GHz). Paper labels the result 'GigaBREAD-0' in Fig. 4. No numerical table provided; limit encoded as approximately flat bound at chi = 1e-12 over the stated mass range per the abstract/conclusion text.
